swing_ideas.text: Big retest of the prior breakout level. Friday has a look below and fail on the 223 level as well. If buyers can step up, looking for a rotation back to the swing high.
Tight balance range on the daily with clear breakout level IF its going to go. Thin structure to retrace on an upside move. Not interested if it never breaks.
Great looking bull flag at the all time high. Any higher low pullback that continues ideally stays over the 114 level. Great relative strength to the broad market.

Simple bottom fishing play with an inverted head and shoulders in force. Looking for a move to pullback and hold the neckline at 170.6 or break the overhead supply low at 180.75. Overall target on a stronger trend reversal would be 202.5 and then monitoring for continuation.

Massive Brigade Bolt™ happening on the weekly breakout level. Pulling back from all time highs. This is a huge watch with the hammer from Friday. Not interested if we start to see price acceptance below the 99.65 level. So far Friday suggests this is in play.

Not in love with the move under the breakout level. This is a two step watch. Needs to get back over 52 to be in play, and then needs to offer a bullish setup. Until that happens, it falls into the failed breakout category.

Reload from last week. Higher low balance in place and still thinking about moves through the 367.6 to get through the thin structure breakdown off to the left. Target is 392.3. Will remain in play as long as the range holds over the moving average cluster.

S&P hourly chart – Given out base case above, here are some potential ways in which the pathing could unfold to accomplish lower highs below 590.25. The look below and fail on Thursday / Friday becomes more evident on this view also.

Market internals – Internals show us the degree of two sided trade that was taking place last week. Yes the market has moved lower, but under the conditions that there has been some violent intraday counter trend moves. A hallmark of volatility.

Market profile – Note that value on Friday has moved to close back inside of the two day balance range. Suggests that the look below and fail is valid, and sellers are starting to *temporarily* "run out of bullets" at the lows. Doesn't mean new money buyers are here, but it does mean the counter trend seems reasonable.
